question: Should maintainers land this compact skills prompt format change now, accepting the compatibility and session-refresh impact after exact-head gates?
rationale: The patch is technically clean and proven, but it intentionally changes model-visible prompt content and persisted session snapshot refresh behavior for existing users with tight skills prompt budgets.

options.title: Land After Exact-Head Gates
options.body: Accept the prompt-shape and snapshot-refresh change because the PR includes versioning, focused tests, changed-surface checks, and live prompt proof.

options.title: Refresh Merge Proof First
options.body: Require a rebase or merge-queue run against current main before landing if maintainers want fresh proof on the exact merge result.

options.title: Pause For Broader Skills Policy
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want compact descriptions bundled with omitted-key recovery, priority, or smart-loading policy instead of landing the narrower fix now.

recommendation.title: Land After Exact-Head Gates
recommendation.body: Accept the prompt-shape and snapshot-refresh change because the PR includes versioning, focused tests, changed-surface checks, and live prompt proof.
